title: Scientists discover that necks didn't evolve for the reason we thought
caption:
New research suggests the first necks didn't evolve for head movement after all. By studying modern sturgeon and ancient fossils, scientists found these early structures were likely designed for walking instead.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover that necks didn't evolve for the reason we thought

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261108233101.htm
